## Quick exploratory analysis


```{r}

d <- tar_read(data_raw) |>
    df_rename() |>
    df_select_cols_recoding() |>
    df_recode()

```

### Sex and species

#### Frequency of values

```{r}

d |>
    select(Sex_2, Species_2) |>
    map(tabyl)

```


### Adversity indicators

#### Frequency of values

**Threat indicators**

Coding scheme:

| Variable        | Score          | Item description                                               |
| -------------   | -------------- | --------------                                                 |
| Life experience | 1              | Zoo (born in the former zoo and spent their life in captivity) |
|                 | 2              | Trade (rescued from poaching)                                  |
|                 | 3              | Pet (chains, cages, etc)                                       |
|                 | 3              | Entertainment (being caged in resorts, temples, etc)           |
| Physical harm   | 1              | No physical harm                                               |
|                 | 2              | Indirect (mobility restriction, chains, cage..)                |
|                 | 3              | Direct (beats, scars..)                                        |

```{r}

d |>
    select(all_of(ind_threat)) |>
    map(tabyl)

```
 
**Deprivation indicators**

Coding scheme:

| Variable                 | Score          | Item description                                                  |
| -------------            | -------------- | --------------                                                    |
| Type of rearing          | 1              | Parenting (reared by biological parents or surogate mother/father |
|                          | 2              | Hand (reared by humans)                                           |
| Infancy social exposure  | 1              | Accompanied by peers 80% infancy                                  |
|                          | 2              | Mixed or accompanied by peers 80-20% infancy                      |
|                          | 3              | Alone more than 80% infancy                                       |
| Juvenile social exposure | 1              | Accompanied by peers 80% juvenility                               |
|                          | 2              | Mixed or accompanied by peers 80-20% juvenility                   |
|                          | 3              | Alone more than 80% juvenility                                    |
| Nutrition deprivation    | 1              | Balanced (mostly balanced during life, adequate food items)       |
|                          | 2              | Unbalanced (poor, harmful foods like soda or snacks…)             |
| Mother separation        | 1              | No                                                                |
|                          | 2              | Yes                                                               |

```{r}

d |>
    select(all_of(ind_deprivation)) |>
    map(tabyl)

```

___NB: Mother separation is not used as an unpredictability indicator but a
       deprivation indicator contrary to what was declared in the
       preregistration.___

**Unpredictability indicators**

Coding scheme:

| Variable              | Score          | Item description                                                     |
| -------------         | -------------- | --------------                                                       |
| Number of relocations | 1              | born at the center                                                   |
|                       | 2              | relocated at least once (to the rescue center)                       |
|                       | 3              | relocated at least twice (usually market + rescue center)            |
|                       | 4              | relocated more than twice (more than two environments before center) |

```{r}

d |>
    select(all_of(ind_unpredictability)) |>
    map(tabyl)

```

___NB: Mother separation is not used as an unpredictability indicator but a
       deprivation indicator contrary to what was declared in the
       preregistration.___


#### Correlation plot

We do not include `PhysicalHarm` and `NutritionDep` in the correlation plots
below since both variables have a really high number of missing values.

**Variables with complete cases**

```{r}

d_cor <- d |> select(all_of(c(ind_threat, ind_deprivation,
                              ind_unpredictability))) |>
              select(-NutritionDep, -PhysicalHarm, -InfancySocialExposure, -JuvenileSocialExposure)
M <- cor(d_cor)
corrplot(M, method = "circle")

```

Correlation between `MotherSeparation` and `LifeExperience` is high:
`r round(cor(d$MotherSeparation, d$LifeExperience), 2)`.


**Including social exposure**

```{r}

d_cor <- d |> select(all_of(c(ind_threat, ind_deprivation,
                              ind_unpredictability))) |>
              select(-NutritionDep, -PhysicalHarm) |>
              filter(InfancySocialExposure >= 1, JuvenileSocialExposure >= 1)
M <- cor(d_cor)
corrplot(M, method = "circle")

```

If we restrict the data to individuals for which `InfancySocialExposure` and
`JuvenileSocialExposure` are known (which is the case for the correlation
plot above), the correlation becomes really high:
`r round(cor(d_cor$MotherSeparation, d_cor$LifeExperience), 2)`.


## Regression models

### Model 1A

```{r}

fit_model1A <- tar_read(fit_model1A)

summary(fit_model1A)

mcmc_plot(fit_model1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Anxiety_Threat")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(fit_model1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Depression_Threat")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(fit_model1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_ISS_Threat")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(fit_model1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Anxiety_Deprivation")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(fit_model1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Depression_Deprivation")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(fit_model1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_ISS_Deprivation")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(fit_model1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Anxiety_Unpredictability")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(fit_model1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_Depression_Unpredictability")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

mcmc_plot(fit_model1A, type = "dens", variable = c("b_ISS_Unpredictability")) +
    labs(x = expression(beta[k]))

pp_check(fit_model1A, resp = "Anxiety", ndraws = 50) + 
  ggplot2::ggtitle("Model 1A: Posterior Predictive Check (Anxiety)") +
    xlim(c(-3, 3))

pp_check(fit_model1A, resp = "Depression", ndraws = 50) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle("Model 1A: Posterior Predictive Check (Depression)") +
    xlim(c(-3, 3))
pp_check(fit_model1A, resp = "ISS", ndraws = 50) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle("Model 1A: Posterior Predictive Check (ISS)") +
    xlim(c(-3, 3))

plot(conditional_effects(fit_model1A), points = TRUE, ask = FALSE)

check_diag_measures(fit_model1A)

```
